info.title: Tikway OpenAI API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs through the Tikway gateway.

model.description: The model ID used to generate the reply, such as gpt-5.6-sol or o3.

messages.description: List of conversation messages as of current date.

role.description: Message author role. Newer inference models recommend using developer instead of system.

name.description: Optional participant name used to distinguish different participants under the same role.

content.description: Message content. It can be a string, or an array composed of text, pictures, audio, and file content blocks. The assistant tool call message can be null.

text.description: The text content when type is text.

refusal.description: The rejection message when type is refusal.

image_url.description: Image input when type is image_url.

url.description: Image URL or Base64-encoded image data.

detail.description: Level of detail for picture understanding.

input_audio.description: Audio input when type is input_audio.

file.description: File input when type is file.

file_id.description: The ID of the uploaded file.

prompt_cache_breakpoint.description: The exact end position of the reusable prompt word prefix.

tool_call_id.description: When role is tool, the tool call ID to which this message responds.

tool_calls.description: List of tool calls generated by the model when role is assistant.

function_call.description: Legacy function call information, deprecated, please use tool_calls.

audio.description: The message of the previous model audio reply.
Audio output parameters. Required when modalities contains audio.

voice.description: The sound used by the model can be a built-in sound name or a custom sound object.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values ​​make the output more random; usually adjusted with top_p alternatively.

top_p.description: Kernel sampling threshold; usually adjusted alternatively with temperature.

n.description: The number of candidate responses generated for each input.

stream.description: Whether to return incremental results in SSE streaming.

stream_options.description: Additional configuration for streaming output, only takes effect when stream is true.

include_usage.description: Whether to return usage information in the final statistics block.

max_completion_tokens.description: The maximum number of generated tokens, including visible output and inference tokens.

frequency_penalty.description: Frequency penalty. Positive values ​​reduce duplicate expressions.

presence_penalty.description: There are penalties. This is a great time to encourage models to introduce new content.

logit_bias.description: Specifies the generation tendency of the word element. The attribute is named token ID and has values ​​from -100 to 100.

logprobs.description: Whether to return the log probability of the output token.

top_logprobs.description: The number of high-probability candidate tokens returned for each output position; logprobs needs to be enabled at the same time.

stop.description: Stop sequence, some new models do not support it.

oneOf.description: Output according to the specified JSON Schema.

tools.description: A list of callable tools provided to the model.

tool_choice.description: Controls whether the model calls the tool, automatically selects the tool, or forces the specified tool to be called.

oneOf.description: Force a custom tool to be called.
Limit the set of tools that can be called.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model is allowed to call multiple tools in parallel.

reasoning_effort.description: Inference strength settings for trade-offs between speed, cost, and inference depth.

seed.description: A random seed used to try to make the output reproducible.

store.description: Whether to store the output of this request.

prompt_cache_key.description: Stable key for hint word cache.

prompt_cache_retention.description: The length of time the prompt word cache is retained.

safety_identifier.description: A stable end-user identifier used to assist in detecting abuse and should not be directly personally identifiable information.

user.description: Old version of end user identification, it is recommended to use safety_identifier.

user_location.description: Approximate location of the user, used to improve localized search relevancy.

oneOf.description: Forces the specified function to be called.

moderation.description: Configuration to perform auditing on request input and build output.

model.description: Audit model ID, such as omni-moderation-latest.

function.description: Get the current weather in a given location

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA

schema.description: Chat Completions non-streaming responses (chat.completion). "Generate via JSON etc. → JSON Schema" direct import for Apifox.

id.description: The unique ID of this chat completion.

created.description: Unix timestamp of the time the response was created, in seconds.

model.description: The actual model ID used to generate the reply.

choices.description: A list of candidate responses generated by the model.

index.description: The sequence number of the candidate reply, starting from 0.

finish_reason.description: The reason for the end of the generation: stop is the natural end, length is the length limit reached, tool_calls is the tool call, and content_filter is content filtering.

role.description: Message author role, fixed to assistant.

content.description: Text content generated by the model; may be null when the tool is called.

refusal.description: Description generated when the model rejects a request.

annotations.description: Reply to comments such as URL references.

start_index.description: The starting character index of the quoted text.

end_index.description: The ending character index of the quoted text.

url.description: The URL of the referring page.

id.description: The unique ID of the audio response.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp of the audio data expiration time, in seconds.

tool_calls.description: A list of tools called by the model request.

id.description: The unique ID of the tool call.

name.description: The name of the function called by the model.

arguments.description: Function parameters in the form of JSON strings should be parsed and verified before use.

logprobs.description: Outputs log-probability information for tokens; only returned if logprobs is enabled on request.

content.description: Output the probability information of each token in the content.

bytes.description: The UTF-8 byte sequence corresponding to the token.

logprob.description: The logarithmic probability of this token.

top_logprobs.description: The most likely candidate token for this position.

usage.description: Word usage statistics for this request.

prompt_tokens.description: Enter the number of tokens used in the prompt word.

completion_tokens.description: The number of tokens used by the model to generate content.

total_tokens.description: The total number of tokens requested.

cached_tokens.description: The number of tokens in the input that hit the cache.

audio_tokens.description: The number of audio tokens in the input.

image_tokens.description: Number of image tokens in the input.

text_tokens.description: The number of text tokens in the input.

cache_write_tokens.description: The number of original tokens written to the prompt word cache.

reasoning_tokens.description: The number of tokens used by the model for inference.

audio_tokens.description: The number of audio tokens generated by the model.

text_tokens.description: The number of text tokens generated by the model.

accepted_prediction_tokens.description: The number of predicted tokens that actually appear in the generated results.

rejected_prediction_tokens.description: The number of predicted tokens that did not appear in the generated results.

service_tier.description: The actual service level used to handle this request.

system_fingerprint.description: The backend configuration fingerprint for the model to run on.

message.content: Hello! How can I help you?
Hello! Nice to meet you. Is there anything I can do to help you?

model.description: The model ID used to generate the response, such as gpt-5.6-sol.

input.description: Text, image, audio, or file input provided to the model. It can be a string directly or an array of input messages.

oneOf.description: Input message or list of previous response output items.

type.description: Input type; can be a message, function call and result, inference, or other supported response item.

content.description: Message content; can be a string or an array of content blocks.

type.description: Content block type, such as input_text, input_image, input_file, or input_audio.

image_url.description: The image URL or Base64 data of input_image.

detail.description: Level of detail for picture understanding.

file_id.description: The ID of the uploaded file.

ref_id.description: The ID of the referenced item.

instructions.description: System or developer directive that inserts into the model context. When using previous_response_id, instructions from the previous response are not automatically inherited.

previous_response_id.description: The unique ID of the previous Response, used for multi-turn conversations; cannot be used at the same time as conversation.

conversation.description: The session to which this response belongs. Session items are automatically added to this context, and input and output items are also written to the session.

background.description: Whether to run model responses in the background.

include.description: Specifies additional data that needs to be included in the response.

max_output_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens allowed in the generated response, including visible output and inference tokens.

max_tool_calls.description: The maximum number of total built-in tool calls that can be processed in a response.

metadata.description: Up to 16 key-value pair metadata; keys can be up to 64 characters and values can be up to 512 characters.

moderation.description: Configuration to perform auditing on request input and build output.

model.description: Audit model ID, such as omni-moderation-latest.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to allow models to call tools in parallel.

prompt.description: Prompt word template and its variables.

prompt_cache_key.description: Stable key used to improve cache hit rate for similar requests; replaces user field.

mode.description: Cache breakpoint mode. explicit turns off implicit breakpoints.

comparison_response_id.description: Comparison response ID used to diagnose cache reuse.

prewarm.description: Only warms up the prompt word cache and does not generate output.

mode.description: Speculative execution mode, common values are standard or pro.

safety_identifier.description: A stable end-user identifier to assist in detecting abuse; it is recommended to use a hash of the username or email address.

store.description: Whether to store the generated Response for subsequent retrieval through the API.

stream.description: Whether to return events as SSE streaming.

stream_options.description: Streaming option, only set when stream is true.

include_obfuscation.description: Whether to include obfuscated fields for streaming events.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; usually adjusted with top_p alternatively.

top_p.description: Kernel sampling threshold; usually adjusted alternatively with temperature.

text.description: Text or structured JSON output configuration.

tools.description: Tools that the model can call when generating responses, including function, web_search, file_search, code_interpreter, computer, MCP, etc.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of function input parameters.

strict.description: Whether the function parameters strictly follow the Schema.

vector_store_ids.description: The vector used by file_search stores a list of IDs.

tool_choice.description: Controls how the model selects tools.

type.description: The type of tool to select.

name.description: The name of the tool to be forced to be called.

top_logprobs.description: The maximum number of high-probability tokens returned for each output position.

truncation.description: Deprecated. The truncation strategy for input when it exceeds the context window.

access_programs.description: Request a domain access plan to use.

id.description: The unique ID of the Response.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of the creation time of the Response, in seconds.

completed_at.description: Unix timestamp of response completion time; only appears if status is completed.

output_text.description: SDK convenience field: The concatenation of all text content in the output.

output.description: A list of outputs generated by the model, the order and number of which depends on the model response.

role.description: message The role of the output item.

content.description: message The content block of the output item.

text.description: The text of output_text or summary_text.

annotations.description: Text annotations, such as file references or URL references.

file_id.description: The ID of the referenced file.

filename.description: The name of the referenced file.

end_index.description: The end character position of the quote.

logprobs.description: Token log probability information, returned only when include requests this data.

name.description: The called function or custom tool name.

arguments.description: Function call parameters in JSON string form.

encrypted_content.description: Encrypted inference content; required via include request.

reason.description: Incomplete reasons such as max_output_tokens or content_filter.

instructions.description: The system or developer directive that applies to this response.

conversation.description: The session to which this response belongs.

previous_response_id.description: The ID of the previous Response.

cached_tokens.description: The number of input tokens that hit the cache.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning about the number of tokens.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to allow parallel tool calls.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature used by this response.

top_p.description: The kernel sampling threshold used by this response.

max_output_tokens.description: The maximum number of output tokens requested.

max_tool_calls.description: The maximum number of tool calls requested to be set.

background.description: Whether to run in the background.

safety_identifier.description: The security identifier requested to be used.
